heading: Everything as code — *infrastructure* included.
body:
I'm a cloud and DevOps engineer and a Computer Science & Artificial Intelligence graduate from Capital University in Cairo. I treat infrastructure the way good engineers treat software: declared in code, reviewed, versioned and deployed by pipelines — never clicked together by hand.

I build on AWS across compute, serverless, networking and IAM; containerise workloads with Docker and Kubernetes; run keyless CI/CD in GitHub Actions with OIDC federation; and define infrastructure in Terraform, CloudFormation and SAM. Security and cost are part of the design from the start: least-privilege IAM, locked-down S3, CloudWatch alarms and budget alerts.

I'm comfortable on Linux, with practical experience in VPC design, cloud security and incident response — and I'm looking for DevOps and Cloud Engineering roles, on-site, hybrid or remote.
highlights: AWS: EC2, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, VPC, IAM
Docker, Kubernetes & k3s · GitOps with ArgoCD

availability.text: Open to DevOps & Cloud roles · on-site, hybrid or remote
